item.title: BLACKPINK’s LISA to star in Netflix’s 'Extraction' spin-off 'TYGO' with Don Lee & Lee Jin-uk
item.description: LISA is stepping into the action spotlight. The BLACKPINK superstar has officially joined the cast of TYGO, a new Korean spin-off in Netflix’s Extraction universe — marking her first major Korean film role. TYGO will see LISA star alongside Korean action legend Don Lee (Train to Busan, The Roundup) and Lee Jin-uk (Sweet Home, Squid Game) in a high-stakes thriller that puts a Korean spin on the globally popular franchise. item.description: KRYSTAL has officially launched her solo era. item.title: Kubra Commander unleashes genre-bending 3rd album 'Metabolic' — listen
item.description: Cebu indie artist Kubra Commander is back with a sonic surge — unveiling his third studio album Metabolic, out now on all platforms.
